contributions.detail: Seventeen rows across two pages sum to EXACTLY 6480.60, which is both the schedule's own printed grand total ($6,480.60 at the foot of page 2) and the cover's line-1 'Totals from this Report' cell. It is NOT the cumulative $31,170.60, so this ledger is genuinely PER-PERIOD (the report covers June 18 to November 1, 2016) - a different scope from the cumulative figure this module publishes, which is expected to leave reconciles_* blank downstream and is not a failure. Cover line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) reads $0.00 in all three columns and is not itemised, so Form A was scored against line 1 alone - note however that the filer itemised three sub-$50 items anyway ($30.00, $0.39, $0.21), which is why line 2 is zero.

expenditures.detail: Eighteen rows across two pages sum to EXACTLY 7581.27 = the schedule's printed grand total = the cover's line-3 'Totals from this Report'. Per-period, same as Form A.

gates.page_subtotal: Contributions: p1 rows (11) 2180.60 + p2 rows (6) 4300.00 = 6480.60 = printed grand total $6,480.60 - EXACT. Expenditures: p1 rows (11) 3821.39 + p2 rows (7) 3759.88 = 7581.27 = printed grand total $7,581.27 - EXACT. Both gates fired and closed to the cent on the first pass, with no escalation needed on any amount.
gates.row_count: This is a typed spreadsheet with an underline per row rather than a boxed grid, and it is stored landscape, so rowbands.py was not the right instrument; rows were counted by INK on the rotated 200 dpi renders and cross-checked by the exact arithmetic. Contributions 11 rows on p1 + 6 on p2 = 17. Expenditures 11 on p1 + 7 on p2 = 18. On both sides the number of dates equals the number of names equals the number of amounts (field-shift screen passed); the two Facebook contribution rows whose ADDRESS cell reads 'promotion credit' were checked specifically for a column shift and are not shifted - the amount and date cells are correctly populated.
gates.geometry_proof: Contributions: p1 first-row band renders '$500.00' and p1 last(11th)-row band renders '$100.00' with the control one pitch beyond rendering empty; p2 last(17th)-row band renders '$200.00' and its control one pitch beyond renders EMPTY. Expenditures: p1 first-row band renders '$1,633.26', p1 last(11th) renders '$60.93'; p2 last(18th) renders '$432.00' and its control renders empty (bare rule only). This page is stored LANDSCAPE and poppler renders it in PORTRAIT with the text lying on its side (read by rotating 90 degrees clockwise). Per the contract this geometry is given in the UN-ROTATED portrait frame poppler renders, so a row's amount cell is a TALL NARROW band: x advances down the ledger and y is the column's position across the printed sheet.
gates.balance_chain: Every printed relation on the cover closes exactly: 24,690.00 + 6,480.60 = 31,170.60; 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00; 22,664.18 + 7,581.27 = 30,245.45; 2,025.82 + (-1,100.67) = 925.15; and across the lines 31,170.60 - 30,245.45 = 925.15, while this period alone is 6,480.60 - 7,581.27 = -1,100.67. Both itemised schedules also equal their THIS-REPORT cells to the cent, so the cover, the schedules and the balance line are mutually consistent. No earlier filing by this filer is in my chunk, so no cross-filing chain was run.

escalation_note: 600 dpi single-cell crops in the un-rotated portrait frame (then rotated for reading) for the geometry proof on both sides of both pages; the amounts themselves are typed and needed no value escalation.
notes: THE DOCUMENT CONTRADICTS THE CHUNK FILE ON OFFICE, LOUDLY: the chunk file (from index.csv) says 'Commission Seat C'; the form's own title line reads 'COUNTY COMMISSION SEAT A CANDIDATE' and its Office line reads 'County Commission', Representative District 'Washington County'. Transcribed from the form. A human should reconcile the seat letter before this filing is compared with other Cox filings. Candidate 'Dean J. Cox' and the 2016 cycle both agree with the chunk file (Date: October 26, 2016; clerk RECEIVED stamp OCT 26 2016; period June 18 - November 1, 2016). A FIFTH FORM VARIANT, unlike any of the three in the county addendum: a LANDSCAPE typed spreadsheet headed 'COUNTY COMMISSION SEAT A CANDIDATE / FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT' citing UTAH CODE 20A-11-1301 through 20A-11-1305 (the state county-candidate statute) rather than Utah Code 17-16-6.5 or the Washington County ordinance - and it puts BOTH schedules side by side on the same sheet as the cover, continuing onto page 2. There is no In-Kind column on either schedule, so in_kind is false everywhere by ABSENCE of the field. PAGE ROTATION: both pages are stored landscape and render sideways in poppler's portrait frame; every pct geometry here is expressed in that un-rotated portrait frame as the contract requires, which makes each amount cell a tall narrow band. Privacy: the cover prints the candidate's street address and two phone numbers, and every contribution row prints a full street address and ZIP - all discarded at read time; only city and state were kept, and the two rows whose address cell reads 'promotion credit' are left with empty city/state rather than being given one. This is a strong CALIBRATION-SPECIMEN CANDIDATE for the landscape/rotated-page and portrait-frame-geometry rules.
